title: DiamondsToBank
body:
DiamondToBank is a simple and convenient plugin for Minecraft Paper 1.21.1 that allows players to deposit items (such as diamonds) to their virtual account (via Vault) and withdraw items from their account. The plugin supports commission configuration, customizable deposit and withdrawal items, and easy message editing with MiniMessage.

## Features

/deposit — deposit items held in hand to your account (with configurable commission).

/take <number> — withdraw a specified amount of items from your account.

/diamondtobankreload — reload configuration and messages without restarting the server.

Full MiniMessage support for colored and formatted messages.

Configuration via config.yml and messages.yml.

## Requirements
Paper 1.21-1.21.1

Vault

EssentialsX (or another Vault-compatible plugin)

## Configuration
deposit_item — item for depositing to account.

deposit_commission — commission on deposits.

take_item — item for withdrawal from account.

All messages can be customized via messages.yml.
